title: Boston Gas Company files a 366/365 Day Firm Transportation Agreement between Boston Gas Company and United States Gypsum Company.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Transportation Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms and minimum quantity of terms to be transported under the agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul b. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
